Economic Consulting Summer Analyst - Meridian Economics Group (Summer 2027)

Support economic analysis in antitrust and regulatory matters. Core work includes quantitative analysis, financial modeling, and document synthesis. Analysts use Stata and Excel daily.

Responsibilities:
- Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modeling in Stata and Excel.
- Synthesize case documents and research records.
- Prepare expert presentation materials and present findings.
- Support economic research across practice areas.

Qualifications:
- Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree.
- Must be authorized to work in the US.
- Strong academic performance required, GPA 3.5 or higher preferred.
- Experience with Python is a plus.

Additional notes:
- Prepare presentations for expert witnesses using Microsoft PowerPoint.
- Demonstrate analytical rigor in every deliverable.
- Collaborate with teammates on case teams.
